title: Spot a compaction and read its summary
done: That is it: the marker is marked for the agent to discuss.

steps.caption: When the context fills, Claude Code compacts it, and the Trail marks the place.
The marker says when, by whom, and how much was replaced by a summary.
Below it is the summary the agent carried on from: what it now knows of the work before.
Your turn: double-click the marker to ask the agent about it.
